_about: Example 3: a made-up board and made-up games (the CRCs are not real) showing every advanced feature: donor PCBs, an inverted switch, per-donor outputs and patches, a script step, fill and pad steps. See docs/KIT_GUIDE.md.
name: Example Board 4-in-1 (template)
board: Example Board, rev A or rev B
description: Template kit with made-up games, for learning the format

selector.title: Rotary switch
selector.note: The switch is wired inverted: EPROM bank 01 is selected at position 2.

donors.title: Example Board rev A (27C256 sound ROM)
Example Board rev B (27C512 sound ROM)

exshoot.title: Example Shooter (World)
exshoot._how: snd_a or snd_b: only the output for the chosen donor board is built. On rev B the 32K sound data is listed twice to fill the 64K slot (the game ignores the extra address line).

exshootj.title: Example Shooter (Japan)
exshootj._how: A clone: sets lists the clone first, then its parent, because the graphics and sound files are only in the parent's zip (split sets).

exracer.title: Example Racer [patched]
exracer._how: graft.py copies the 2K track table from er.tbl into the program at 0x7000, {donor} picks ips/boardA or ips/boardB, and the 32K program is padded with FF to the 64K slot.

boardB._how: On rev B the kit uses the 64K sound ROM from the exracerb set instead. An override replaces the whole key, so roms and parts are given in full.

expuzzle.title: Example Puzzle
expuzzle._how: donors: [boardB] hides this game unless rev B is chosen. It has no snd_a part, which is fine because snd_a is never built for rev B.
